About the Role

As Head of Business & Growth for GoPay Later, you’ll own the growth of product by combining business understanding, data, and customer insights to find where the next wave of growth and opportunity will come from. You’ll turn those opportunities into go-to-market plans across product and marketing and drive them from strategy through execution and measurement, with clear accountability. Lead the team, set clear direction, and develop people to deliver aspirational goals.

What You Will Do

• Own GoPay Later’s growth strategy and targets for users, transactions, and GTV, and translate them into a clear strategy of prioritized initiatives.
• Identify new growth opportunities through data analysis, customer research, and market understanding, including new user segments, use cases, merchants, and ecosystem touchpoints.
• Develop go-to-market plans for new and existing initiatives, marketing campaigns, and partnership levers.
• Develop the product roadmap, leveraging customer insights and data to decide which features and improvements to build and in the right order of priority.
• Drive cross-functional execution with Marketing, Product, Risk, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, aligning priorities and removing blockers to get initiatives live.
• Work with the credit risk team to balance growth with credit quality, ensuring initiatives grow the portfolio responsibly.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team.

What You Will Need

• 8+ years of experience in business growth, strategy, or product/business management roles in the BNPL or consumer lending industry.
• Proven track record of driving measurable growth in user, transaction, or revenue metrics for a consumer product.
• Solid understanding of credit products and the trade-off between growth and risk.
• Strong data analytical skills; comfortable working hands-on with data to find insights, size opportunities, and evaluate impact.
• Experience taking initiatives end to end, from opportunity identification and GTM planning to execution and post-launch measurement.
• Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, including with senior stakeholders.

About the Team

You’ll be part of the GoPayLater team, which builds and grows BNPL products within the GoTo ecosystem. Our mission is to make flexible, responsible credit accessible to millions of Indonesians, many of whom are underserved by traditional financial institutions. We are a tight-knit group who are bonded by two things: our genuine desire to add value to the lives of our consumers and the growth mindset and passion to make an impact. Our team enjoys what we do since we get to see the impact of our work reflected in our consumer's everyday lives. Come join our family to see what we mean!

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

Ringkasan Pekerjaan**

Operator Produksi bertanggung jawab untuk mengoperasikan dan memelihara mesin serta peralatan produksi untuk memastikan kelancaran proses produksi pakan ternak sesuai standar kualitas dan target yang ditetapkan.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan**

* Mengoperasikan mesin produksi sesuai prosedur operasional standar (SOP).
* Melakukan pengecekan rutin terhadap kondisi mesin dan peralatan produksi.
* Memastikan ketersediaan bahan baku dan bahan pembantu yang diperlukan dalam proses produksi.
* Mengawasi dan mengontrol proses produksi agar berjalan sesuai jadwal dan spesifikasi.
* Melakukan pencatatan data produksi secara akurat dan tepat waktu.
* Melakukan pemeliharaan ringan pada mesin dan peralatan produksi.
* Melaporkan setiap masalah atau kerusakan pada mesin/peralatan kepada atasan.
* Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area kerja.
* Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar keselamatan kerja dan prosedur kualitas.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan**

* Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat, diutamakan dari jurusan Teknik Mesin, Teknik Industri, atau terkait.
* Pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun sebagai Operator Produksi, diutamakan di industri pakan ternak atau manufaktur.
* Mampu mengoperasikan mesin produksi dengan baik.
* Memiliki pemahaman dasar tentang proses produksi dan kontrol kualitas.
* Teliti, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab.
* Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim.
* Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.
* Sehat jasmani dan rohani.

Job Responsibilities**

* Execute a variety of molecular biology techniques, including DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, and sequencing.
* Prepare and analyze samples, ensuring proper handling, labeling, and storage protocols are followed.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, including thermal cyclers, centrifuges, spectrophotometers, and genetic analyzers.
* Document experimental procedures, observations, and results accurately and thoroughly in laboratory notebooks and databases.
* Perform data analysis and interpretation, drawing conclusions and preparing reports.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize experimental protocols as needed.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment, adhering to all safety guidelines and regulations.
* Collaborate effectively with team members and other departments.
* Stay updated on new molecular biology techniques and technologies.
* Assist in the development and validation of new molecular assays.

Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field.
* Proven experience (1+ years) working in a molecular biology laboratory setting, preferably in an industrial or research environment.
* Strong theoretical and practical understanding of molecular biology principles and techniques.
* Proficiency in DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, and gel electrophoresis.
* Experience with sequencing technologies (e.g., Sanger, NGS) is a plus.
* Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) is advantageous.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
